title: I made a multiplayer game that was 100% coded with AI.
author: Roma2443
selftext:
I made a multiplayer game that was 100% coded with AI.

Around 90% of the art comes from the Tiny Swords asset pack, and I used AI to generate a few additional sprites that match its style.

The game is a feature-rich 1v1 RTS with replays, a spectator mode, and even built-in tournament brackets with cash prizes. Matches can be launched directly from the bracket, making tournaments fully integrated into the game.

I'm currently waiting for Steam KYC approval so I can release it as a free-to-play game. At the same time, I'm working on a single-player mode to make it accessible to a much wider audience.

With the gameplay video, does it come across as AI slop, or does it feel like a legitimate game?

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body: Funny, I build the exact same thing a couple weeks back. Using exactly the same assets. I stopped when the peon unit ai took over my life .p
